topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation, explaining how previously introduced immune components integrate to generate immune responses.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by the Innate Immune System
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the innate immune system detects infections and tissue injury through conserved molecular patterns and dedicated pattern recognition receptor signaling cascades.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascade, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the cellular and vascular events that propagate the acute inflammatory response, coordinate leukocyte trafficking to tissues and lymphatics, and trigger systemic outcomes.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms that shut down acute inflammation, direct tissue repair, and sustain chronic inflammatory conditions when resolution is incomplete.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture and announces the upcoming topic.
